        docsEls.deleteBtn.disabled = docsBusy || sel === 0;
        docsEls.addBtn.disabled = docsBusy;
        docsEls.refreshBtn.disabled = docsBusy;
        const checks = docsEls.list.querySelectorAll(".doc-check");
        docsEls.selectAll.checked = checks.length > 0 && sel === checks.length;
      }

      function renderDocs() {
        if (!docsCache.length) {
          docsEls.list.innerHTML =
            '<div class="docs-empty">Nenhum documento na base de conhecimento ainda.<br />Use "Adicionar arquivos" para enviar.</div>';
          updateDocsButtons();
          return;
        }
        docsEls.list.innerHTML = docsCache
          .map((d) => {
            const title = docsEscHtml(d.title || d.id);
            const nameHtml = d.url
              ? `<a href="${docsEscHtml(d.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${title}</a>`
              : title;
            return `
            <div class="doc-row" data-id="${docsEscHtml(d.id)}">
              <input type="checkbox" class="doc-check" />
              <i data-lucide="${d.has_schema ? "table" : "file-text"}" style="width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--text-secondary);flex-shrink:0"></i>
              <div class="doc-info">
                <div class="doc-name">${nameHtml}</div>
                <div class="doc-meta">
                  <span>${docsFmtDate(d.created_at)}</span>
                  <span>${Number(d.chunks) || 0} chunks</span>
                  <span class="doc-badge ${d.session_id ? "temp" : ""}">${d.session_id ? "sessão" : "permanente"}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="doc-actions">
                <button class="doc-icon-btn" data-act="reprocess" title="Reprocessar este documento">
                  <i data-lucide="refresh-ccw" style="width:15px;height:15px"></i>
                </button>
                <button class="doc-icon-btn del" data-act="delete" title="Excluir este documento">
                  <i data-lucide="trash-2" style="width:15px;height:15px"></i>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
          })
          .join("");
        lucide.createIcons();
        updateDocsButtons();
      }

      async function fetchDocs() {
        setDocsStatus("Carregando documentos...");
        try {
          const res = await fetch(DOCS_LIST_URL);
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
          let data = await res.json();
          if (!Array.isArray(data)) data = data ? [data] : [];
          docsCache = data.filter((d) => d && d.id);
          renderDocs();
          setDocsStatus(`${docsCache.length} documento(s) na base.`);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Docs list error:", e);
          docsCache = [];
          docsEls.list.innerHTML =
            '<div class="docs-empty">Falha ao carregar a lista.<br />Verifique se o workflow <b>Aspiramaq-Docs-Manager</b> está ativo no n8n.</div>';
          setDocsStatus("Erro ao carregar documentos.", "error");
          updateDocsButtons();
        }
      }

      async function reprocessDocs(ids) {
        if (!ids.length || docsBusy) return;
        docsBusy = true;
        updateDocsButtons();
        setDocsStatus(
          `Reprocessando ${ids.length} documento(s)... isso pode levar alguns minutos.`,
          "warning",
        );
        try {
          const res = await fetch(DOCS_REPROCESS_URL, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ ids }),
          });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
          setDocsStatus(
            `${ids.length} documento(s) reprocessado(s) com sucesso!`,
            "success",
          );
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Docs reprocess error:", e);
          setDocsStatus(
            "Erro ao reprocessar. Verifique o workflow Aspiramaq-RAG no n8n.",
            "error",
          );
        }
        docsBusy = false;
        await fetchDocs();
      }

      function askDeleteDocs(ids) {
        if (!ids.length || docsBusy) return;
        docsPendingDeleteIds = ids;
        docsEls.confirmText.textContent = `Excluir ${ids.length} documento(s) permanentemente (banco + Google Drive)?`;
        docsEls.confirmBar.classList.add("show");
      }

      async function doDeleteDocs(ids) {
        docsEls.confirmBar.classList.remove("show");
        if (!ids || !ids.length) return;
        docsBusy = true;
        updateDocsButtons();
        setDocsStatus(`Excluindo ${ids.length} documento(s)...`, "warning");
        try {
          const res = await fetch(DOCS_DELETE_URL, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ ids }),
          });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
          setDocsStatus(
            `${ids.length} documento(s) excluído(s) com sucesso.`,
            "success",
          );
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Docs delete error:", e);
          setDocsStatus("Erro ao excluir documentos.", "error");
        }
        docsBusy = false;
        docsPendingDeleteIds = null;
        await fetchDocs();
      }

      async function uploadDocsFiles(files) {
        if (!files.length || docsBusy) return;
        docsBusy = true;
        updateDocsButtons();
        let ok = 0;
        let fail = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
          const file = files[i];
          setDocsStatus(
            `Enviando ${i + 1}/${files.length}: ${file.name}...`,
            "warning",
          );
          try {
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append("file", file);
            // Sem sessionId: documento permanente da base de conhecimento
            const res = await fetch(UPLOAD_URL, {
              method: "POST",
              body: formData,
            });
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
            ok++;
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("Docs upload error:", file.name, e);
            fail++;
          }
        }
        setDocsStatus(
          fail === 0
            ? `${ok} arquivo(s) enviado(s) e indexado(s) com sucesso!`
            : `${ok} enviado(s), ${fail} falhou(falharam).`,
          fail === 0 ? "success" : "error",
        );
        docsBusy = false;
        await fetchDocs();
      }

      // Listeners do gerenciador de documentos
      if (docsEls.openBtn) {
        docsEls.openBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          docsEls.modal.classList.add("show");
          lucide.createIcons();
          fetchDocs();
        });
      }
      docsEls.closeBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        docsEls.modal.classList.remove("show");
        docsEls.confirmBar.classList.remove("show");
      });
      docsEls.modal.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target === docsEls.modal) {
          docsEls.modal.classList.remove("show");
          docsEls.confirmBar.classList.remove("show");
        }
      });
      docsEls.refreshBtn.addEventListener("click", fetchDocs);
      docsEls.selectAll.addEventListener("change", () => {
        docsEls.list
          .querySelectorAll(".doc-check")
          .forEach((cb) => (cb.checked = docsEls.selectAll.checked));
        updateDocsButtons();
      });
      docsEls.list.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
        if (e.target.classList.contains("doc-check")) updateDocsButtons();
      });
      docsEls.list.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const btn = e.target.closest("[data-act]");
        if (!btn) return;
        const id = btn.closest(".doc-row").dataset.id;
        if (btn.dataset.act === "reprocess") reprocessDocs([id]);
        else if (btn.dataset.act === "delete") askDeleteDocs([id]);
      });
      docsEls.reprocessBtn.addEventListener("click", () =>
        reprocessDocs(docsSelectedIds()),
      );
      docsEls.deleteBtn.addEventListener("click", () =>
        askDeleteDocs(docsSelectedIds()),
      );
      docsEls.confirmCancel.addEventListener("click", () => {
        docsEls.confirmBar.classList.remove("show");
        docsPendingDeleteIds = null;
      });
      docsEls.confirmOk.addEventListener("click", () =>
        doDeleteDocs(docsPendingDeleteIds),
      );
      docsEls.addBtn.addEventListener("click", () => docsEls.fileInput.click());
      docsEls.fileInput.addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
        const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
        e.target.value = "";
        await uploadDocsFiles(files);
      });

      // ============================================
      // CASOS / HISTÓRICO DE CLIENTES
      // ============================================
      const casesEls = {
        openBtn: document.getElementById("casesBtn"),
        modal: document.getElementById("casesModal"),
        list: document.getElementById("casesList"),
        search: document.getElementById("casesSearch"),
        tabs: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".cases-tab")),
        statusFilter: document.getElementById("casesStatusFilter"),
        refreshBtn: document.getElementById("casesRefreshBtn"),
        closeBtn: document.getElementById("casesCloseBtn"),
        prevBtn: document.getElementById("casesPrevBtn"),
        nextBtn: document.getElementById("casesNextBtn"),
        pageInfo: document.getElementById("casesPageInfo"),
        statusWrap: document.getElementById("casesStatusWrap"),
        status: document.getElementById("casesStatus"),
      };

      const CASES_PAGE_SIZE = 20;
      let casesAll = [];
      let casesFiltered = [];
      let casesPage = 0;
      let casesLoaded = false;
      let casesSource = "formulario";

      const CASE_STATUS_META = {
        aprovado: { icon: "✅", label: "Aprovado" },
        pendente: { icon: "⚠️", label: "Pendente" },
        reprovado: { icon: "❌", label: "Reprovado" },
        desconhecido: { icon: "•", label: "Sem status" },
      };

      function setCasesStatus(msg, type) {
        casesEls.status.textContent = msg || "";
        casesEls.statusWrap.className =
          "docs-status" + (type ? " " + type : "");
      }

      function casesApplyFilters() {
        const term = (casesEls.search.value || "")
          .normalize("NFD")
          .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .trim();
        const src = casesSource;
        const st = casesEls.statusFilter.value;
        casesFiltered = casesAll.filter((c) => {
          if (src && c.source !== src) return false;
          if (st && c.status !== st) return false;
          if (term && !c._search.includes(term)) return false;
          return true;
        });
        casesPage = 0;
        renderCases();
      }

      function renderCases() {
        if (!casesAll.length) {
          casesEls.list.innerHTML =
            '<div class="docs-empty">Nenhum caso encontrado.<br />Verifique se o workflow <b>Aspiramaq-Cases</b> está ativo no n8n.</div>';
          casesEls.pageInfo.textContent = "—";
          casesEls.prevBtn.disabled = true;
          casesEls.nextBtn.disabled = true;
          return;
        }
        if (!casesFiltered.length) {
          casesEls.list.innerHTML =
            '<div class="docs-empty">Nenhum caso bate com o filtro atual.</div>';
          casesEls.pageInfo.textContent = "0 de 0";
          casesEls.prevBtn.disabled = true;
          casesEls.nextBtn.disabled = true;
          return;
        }
        const totalPages = Math.ceil(casesFiltered.length / CASES_PAGE_SIZE);
        if (casesPage >= totalPages) casesPage = totalPages - 1;
        const start = casesPage * CASES_PAGE_SIZE;
        const pageItems = casesFiltered.slice(start, start + CASES_PAGE_SIZE);

        casesEls.list.innerHTML = pageItems
          .map((c) => {
            const stMeta =
              CASE_STATUS_META[c.status] || CASE_STATUS_META.desconhecido;
            const srcLabel =
              c.source === "formulario" ? "Formulário" : "Histórico";
            const metaParts = [];
            if (c.po)
              metaParts.push(`<span>Pó: <b>${docsEscHtml(c.po)}</b></span>`);
            if (c.processo)
              metaParts.push(
                `<span>Processo: <b>${docsEscHtml(c.processo)}</b></span>`,
              );
            if (c.equipamento)
              metaParts.push(
                `<span>Equip.: <b>${docsEscHtml(c.equipamento)}</b></span>`,
              );
            if (c.motor)
              metaParts.push(
                `<span>Motor: <b>${docsEscHtml(c.motor)}</b></span>`,
              );
            if (c.filtro)
              metaParts.push(
                `<span>Filtro: <b>${docsEscHtml(c.filtro)}</b></span>`,
              );
            const obs = c.observacoes
              ? `<div class="case-obs">${docsEscHtml(c.observacoes)}</div>`
              : "";
            return `
            <div class="case-card" data-id="${c._id}">
              <div class="case-card-top">
                <span class="case-client">${docsEscHtml(c.cliente || "(sem nome)")}</span>
                <span class="case-badge src-${c.source}">${srcLabel}</span>
                <span class="case-badge st-${c.status}">${stMeta.icon} ${stMeta.label}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="case-meta">${metaParts.join("")}</div>
              ${obs}
              <div class="case-actions">
                <button class="case-ask-btn" data-act="ask" data-id="${c._id}">
                  <i data-lucide="sparkles" style="width:14px;height:14px"></i>
                  Perguntar à IA sobre este caso
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
          })
          .join("");
        lucide.createIcons();
        casesEls.pageInfo.textContent = `Página ${casesPage + 1} de ${totalPages} · ${casesFiltered.length} caso(s)`;
        casesEls.prevBtn.disabled = casesPage === 0;
        casesEls.nextBtn.disabled = casesPage >= totalPages - 1;
      }

      async function fetchCases(force) {
        if (casesLoaded && !force) {
          renderCases();
          return;
        }
        setCasesStatus("Carregando casos...");
        casesEls.list.innerHTML =
          '<div class="docs-empty">Carregando casos...</div>';
        try {
          const res = await fetch(CASES_URL, { cache: "no-store" });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
          let data = await res.json();
          if (!Array.isArray(data)) data = data ? [data] : [];
          casesAll = data.map((c, i) => {
            const extra = c.fields ? Object.values(c.fields).join(" ") : "";
            const searchBlob = [
              c.cliente,
              c.po,
              c.processo,
              c.equipamento,
              c.motor,
              c.filtro,
              c.observacoes,
              c.aprovacao,
              extra,
            ]
              .join(" ")
              .normalize("NFD")
              .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
              .toLowerCase();
            return { ...c, _id: i, _search: searchBlob };
          });
          casesLoaded = true;
          casesApplyFilters();
          const nHist = casesAll.filter((c) => c.source === "historico").length;
          const nForm = casesAll.filter(
            (c) => c.source === "formulario",
          ).length;
          setCasesStatus(
            `${nForm} formulário(s), ${nHist} histórico(s). Use as abas para alternar.`,
          );
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Cases list error:", e);
          casesAll = [];
          casesFiltered = [];
          renderCases();
          setCasesStatus(
            "Erro ao carregar casos. Verifique o workflow Aspiramaq-Cases no n8n.",
            "error",
          );
        }
      }

      function buildCaseQuestion(c) {
        const origem =
          c.source === "formulario"
            ? "formulário de novo cliente"
            : "histórico real";
        const lines = [
          `Quero solucionar este caso vindo da aba de ${origem}:`,
          "",
        ];
        if (c.cliente) lines.push(`- Cliente: ${c.cliente}`);
        if (c.po) lines.push(`- Pó/Material: ${c.po}`);
        if (c.processo) lines.push(`- Processo: ${c.processo}`);
        if (c.equipamento) lines.push(`- Equipamento: ${c.equipamento}`);
        if (c.motor) lines.push(`- Motor: ${c.motor}`);
        if (c.filtro) lines.push(`- Filtro usado: ${c.filtro}`);
        if (c.aprovacao) lines.push(`- Status/Aprovação: ${c.aprovacao}`);
        if (c.observacoes) lines.push(`- Observações: ${c.observacoes}`);
        // Campos extras (principalmente para casos vindos do formulário)
        if (c.fields) {
          const known = new Set([
            c.cliente,
            c.po,
            c.processo,
            c.equipamento,
            c.motor,
            c.filtro,
            c.aprovacao,
            c.observacoes,
          ]);
          for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(c.fields)) {
            const val = String(v == null ? "" : v).trim();
            if (val && !known.has(val)) lines.push(`- ${k}: ${val}`);
          }
        }
        lines.push("");
        lines.push(
          "Analise como um caso técnico-comercial real. Objetivo: entender o problema, apontar riscos/incoerências, dizer o que provavelmente precisa ser corrigido e propor a melhor recomendação inicial.",
        );
        lines.push(
          "Antes de perguntar qualquer coisa, extraia do próprio texto quais campos já estão respondidos pelo contexto (ex.: material, seco/úmido, quantidade de pontos, simultaneidade, vazão, tensão, restrições). Não pergunte novamente nada que já esteja explícito no caso.",
        );
        lines.push(
          "Obrigatório: consulte a base RAG (`search_knowledge_base`) para regras técnicas aplicáveis e consulte o histórico (`Consultar_Planilha_Inteligente1`, aba `historico`) para encontrar 1 a 3 casos similares que deram certo. Separe claramente: Manual/RAG vs. histórico. Não misture fontes e não invente dado que não retornou.",
        );
        lines.push(
          "Responda de forma pontual: diagnóstico, causa provável, o que recomendar, casos similares aprovados e perguntas críticas ainda não respondidas. Liste no máximo 1 a 3 perguntas pendentes, somente lacunas reais. Não abra QUICK_FORM nem refaça dimensionamento completo a menos que eu peça explicitamente.",
        );
        return lines.join("\n");
      }

      function closeCasesModal() {
        casesEls.modal.classList.remove("show");
      }

      async function askAIAboutCase(c) {
        if (!c) return;
        closeCasesModal();
        if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && mainGrid) {
          mainGrid.classList.add("sidebar-closed");
        }
        startNewChat();
        elements.messageInput.value = buildCaseQuestion(c);
        elements.messageInput.style.height = "auto";
        elements.messageInput.style.height =
          elements.messageInput.scrollHeight + "px";
        await handleSendMessage({ preventDefault: () => {} });
      }

      // Listeners dos casos
      if (casesEls.openBtn) {
        casesEls.openBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          casesEls.modal.classList.add("show");
          lucide.createIcons();
          fetchCases(false);
        });
      }
      casesEls.closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeCasesModal);
      casesEls.modal.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target === casesEls.modal) closeCasesModal();
      });
      casesEls.refreshBtn.addEventListener("click", () => fetchCases(true));
      let casesSearchTimer = null;
      casesEls.search.addEventListener("input", () => {
        clearTimeout(casesSearchTimer);
        casesSearchTimer = setTimeout(casesApplyFilters, 180);
      });
      casesEls.tabs.forEach((tab) => {
        tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
          casesSource = tab.dataset.source || "formulario";
          casesEls.tabs.forEach((t) => {
            const active = t === tab;
            t.classList.toggle("active", active);
            t.setAttribute("aria-selected", active ? "true" : "false");
          });
          casesApplyFilters();
        });
      });
      casesEls.statusFilter.addEventListener("change", casesApplyFilters);
      casesEls.prevBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (casesPage > 0) {
          casesPage--;
          renderCases();
          casesEls.list.scrollTop = 0;
        }
      });
      casesEls.nextBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const totalPages = Math.ceil(casesFiltered.length / CASES_PAGE_SIZE);
        if (casesPage < totalPages - 1) {
          casesPage++;
          renderCases();
          casesEls.list.scrollTop = 0;
        }
      });
      casesEls.list.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const btn = e.target.closest('[data-act="ask"]');
        if (!btn) return;
        const id = Number(btn.dataset.id);
        const c = casesAll.find((x) => x._id === id);
        askAIAboutCase(c);
      });

      // Handle Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line
      elements.messageInput.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleSendMessage(e);
        }
      });

      // Auto-resize textarea
      elements.messageInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
        this.style.height = "auto";
        this.style.height = this.scrollHeight + "px";
      });
      // ============================================
      // INITIALIZATION
      // ============================================
      // Renamed from init -> startApp to imply it starts the heavy lifting
      // let appStarted = false; // Moved to top
      async function startApp() {
        if (appStarted) return; // Prevent double run
        appStarted = true;

        checkHealth();

        console.log("🚀 Starting App...");
        showSkeletonSessions();
        sessions = await fetchSessions();
        console.log("📋 Total sessions:", sessions.length);
        if (sessions.length > 0 && !currentSessionId) {
          await loadSession(sessions[0].session_id);
        } else if (sessions.length === 0) {
          startNewChat();
        }
        renderSessionList();
      }
      elements.sendBtn.addEventListener("click", handleSendMessage);
      elements.newChatBtn.addEventListener("click", startNewChat);

      // Toggle Sidebar
      const toggleSidebarBtn = document.getElementById("toggleSidebarBtn");
      const mainGrid = document.querySelector(".main-grid");
      const sidebarBackdrop = document.getElementById("sidebarBackdrop");
      if (toggleSidebarBtn) {
        toggleSidebarBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          mainGrid.classList.toggle("sidebar-closed");
          lucide.createIcons();
        });
      }

      // Close sidebar when clicking backdrop (mobile)
      if (sidebarBackdrop) {
        sidebarBackdrop.addEventListener("click", () => {
          mainGrid.classList.add("sidebar-closed");
        });
      }

      // On mobile, start with sidebar closed
      function checkMobileAndSetSidebar() {
        if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
          mainGrid.classList.add("sidebar-closed");
        } else {
          mainGrid.classList.remove("sidebar-closed");
        }
      }

      // Check on load and resize
      checkMobileAndSetSidebar();

      window.addEventListener("resize", checkMobileAndSetSidebar);

      // Global Initialization
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        console.log("🏁 DOM Ready - Checking Auth...");
        // Do NOT call init/startApp here directly. Check Auth first.
        checkAuth();
        lucide.createIcons();
      });
    </script>
